description:
Greetings,

We are college students seeking knowledge and development through experience. Our goal for this challenge is to build a public-friendly web tool that visualizes near-infrared time-lapse imagery to easily identify moving cosmic objects. We are seeking passionate team members with experience in UI/UX design, basic python skills, or astronomy API integration to help elevate our platform. we also welcome anyone with no prior experience who is eager to learn, contribute, and collaborate.
